title: Anduril reportedly in talks to raise funding at $100B valuation, more than 3x last year’s mark
summary: Other startups have cashed in, too: Military aircraft maker Shield AI in March raised $1.5 billion, Mach Industries quadrupled its valuation to $1.8 billion last month, and Europe’s Helsing this month raised $1.8 billion at an $18 billion valuation.
